faqs.question: What does a UPS do?
faqs.answer: A UPS keeps your equipment running on its battery when the mains power goes off. It gives you time to save your work and shut down properly, and it also helps protect your equipment from power surges.

faqs.question: How long will it keep my equipment running?
faqs.answer: That depends on how much equipment you plug in. A single computer will run longer than a computer with a monitor, router and other devices all connected. Tell us what you want to power on WhatsApp and we'll advise.

faqs.question: What can I plug into it?
faqs.answer: Use it for computers, routers and similar electronics, and stay within its power rating. Do not plug in heaters, kettles or other high-power appliances. If you're unsure, send us a list of your equipment on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this UPS?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp for the current warranty term before ordering.
